comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body:
Hi @ottojo thanks for completing the issue template, we're in the process of updating our review procedures so there's an additional request before I add the release repository requested.

Can you please open a pull request on [ros/rosdistro](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/) adding a source entry for your repository to [`rolling`](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/master/rolling/distribution.yaml). There is some information about the requirements here: https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#guidelines-for-package-naming

You do not need to perform a complete binary release (since doing so would require a configured release repository) but it's important that your package undergo the license and naming review before a release repository is created.

Thanks and let me know if you have any questions.

comments.author: ottojo
comments.body: Ping @nuclearsandwich , the PR in ros/rosdistro https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/34612 is merged

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body: Thanks for the ping. This team has been created!
